Public Function Make(ByVal path As String, ByVal dressed As Boolean) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, c As Object
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    ws.Name = "One"
    ws.Range("A1:C1").Value = Array("", "Rev", "Cost")
    ws.Range("A2:C2").Value = Array("a", 10, 4)
    ws.Range("A3:C3").Value = Array("b", 20, 6)
    If dressed Then
        Set c = ws.Shapes.AddChart2(201, xlColumnClustered).Chart
        c.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C3")
        c.HasTitle = True
        c.ChartTitle.Text = "Mine"
        c.Legend.Left = 10
        c.PlotArea.Width = 200
        c.SeriesCollection(1).HasDataLabels = True
        c.SeriesCollection(1).Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 65280
        c.SeriesCollection(2).Trendlines.Add
    Else
        Set c = ws.ChartObjects.Add(48, 96, 240, 144).Chart
        c.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C3")
    End If
    wb.SaveAs path, xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    wb.Close False
End Function

Private Sub Edit(ByVal which As Long, c As Object, co As Object, r As Variant)
    Select Case which
    Case 1: c.HasTitle = True: r = c.HasTitle
    Case 2: c.HasTitle = False: r = c.HasTitle
    Case 3: c.HasTitle = True: c.HasTitle = False: r = c.HasTitle
    Case 4: c.HasTitle = True: c.ChartTitle.Text = "T": r = c.ChartTitle.Text
    Case 5: c.HasTitle = True: c.ChartTitle.Delete: r = c.HasTitle
    Case 6: c.HasLegend = False: r = c.HasLegend
    Case 7: c.HasLegend = True: r = c.HasLegend
    Case 8: c.HasLegend = True: c.Legend.Position = xlLegendPositionTop: r = c.Legend.Position
    Case 9: c.Axes(xlValue).HasTitle = True: c.Axes(xlValue).AxisTitle.Text = "V": r = c.Axes(xlValue).AxisTitle.Text
    Case 10: c.Axes(xlValue).MaximumScale = 50: r = c.Axes(xlValue).MaximumScale
    Case 11: c.Axes(xlValue).HasMajorGridlines = False: r = c.Axes(xlValue).HasMajorGridlines
    Case 12: c.SeriesCollection(1).Name = "N": r = c.SeriesCollection(1).Name
    Case 13: c.SeriesCollection(1).Formula = "=SERIES(One!$C$1,One!$A$2:$A$3,One!$C$2:$C$3,1)": r = c.SeriesCollection(1).Formula
    Case 14: c.ChartArea.Font.Size = 14: r = c.ChartArea.Font.Size
    Case 15: c.HasTitle = True: c.ChartTitle.Font.Bold = True: r = c.ChartTitle.Font.Bold
    Case 16: c.SeriesCollection(1).Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 255: r = c.SeriesCollection(1).Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB
    Case 17: c.SeriesCollection(1).HasDataLabels = True: r = c.SeriesCollection(1).HasDataLabels
    Case 18: c.SeriesCollection(1).Points(1).HasDataLabel = True: c.SeriesCollection(1).Points(1).DataLabel.Text = "P": r = c.SeriesCollection(1).Points(1).DataLabel.Text
    Case 19: c.ChartType = xlLine: r = c.ChartType
    Case 20: c.SeriesCollection.NewSeries: r = c.SeriesCollection.Count
    Case 21: c.SeriesCollection(c.SeriesCollection.Count).Delete: r = c.SeriesCollection.Count
    Case 22: c.SetSourceData co.Parent.Range("A1:B3"): r = c.SeriesCollection.Count
    Case 23: co.Activate: r = c.HasTitle
    Case 24: c.HasTitle = False: c.HasTitle = True: r = c.HasTitle
    Case 25: c.HasTitle = True: c.HasTitle = False: c.HasTitle = True: r = c.HasTitle
    Case 26: c.HasTitle = True: c.HasTitle = False: r = c.HasTitle: Err.Clear: r = r & " " & TypeName(c.ChartTitle) & " " & Err.Number
    Case 27: c.HasTitle = True: c.HasTitle = False: co.Activate: r = c.HasTitle
    Case 28: c.HasTitle = True: r = c.ChartTitle.Text
    Case 29: c.HasTitle = True: c.ChartTitle.Delete: c.HasTitle = True: r = c.HasTitle
    End Select
End Sub

Public Function Act(ByVal path As String, ByVal out As String, ByVal which As Long) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, co As Object, c As Object, r As Variant, s As String
    Set wb = Workbooks.Open(path)
    Set co = wb.Worksheets(1).ChartObjects(1)
    Set c = co.Chart
    On Error Resume Next
    Edit which, c, co, r
    s = Err.Number & " " & TypeName(r) & " " & r
    On Error GoTo 0
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    wb.SaveAs out, xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    wb.Close False
    Act = s
End Function
